title: Inclined Pool Starting Platform
description: One original static swimming-pool starting platform visual prop: a broad forward-inclined takeoff deck with integral blue top surface, two arch-legged sculpted side support frames, an elevated rear approach tread, a front U-shaped handgrip and four broad ground pads. Nine closed connected editable meshes and four constant opaque untextured PBR materials. One complete prop, zero scenes; metres, Z up, front -Y, ground Z=0. Entirely new numeric geometry. Static stylised display only: no sporting-event certification, competition regulation, load, grip performance, wet-use suitability, safety, manufacture, installation, adjustability or functional mechanism claim. No swimmer, water, pool building, logo, texture, text or animation.
